title: Combine multiple text files into one
summary: Merge the contents of several text files into a single output file. This is useful for creating a single document from multiple chapters or sections.

steps.explain: Concatenate all matching files in the current directory into a single output file with a specified title.

placeholders.name: FORMAT
placeholders.description: The format of the output file (e.g., html, txt, rtf)

placeholders.name: TITLE
placeholders.description: The title to set for the output document

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the new combined file
